name: United Fuel Driver
tagline: Fuel-card app for US truck drivers — discounted diesel, route planning and support
role: Mobile development for a US fuel-card company

scenes.title: Card, map and support in one app
scenes.body: Card spending, discounted truck stops, repair shops and a support line for drivers.

scenes.title: Discounted diesel on a live map
scenes.body: Retail vs card price at every truck stop, sorted by price or distance in a set radius.

scenes.title: Plan fuel stops on the route
scenes.body: Enter a destination and the map lists discounted truck stops along the way.

scenes.title: Repair shops by truck brand
scenes.body: Maintenance shops on a second map layer, filtered by service type and truck brand.

scenes.title: Support chat per request
scenes.body: Real-time Socket.io messaging for each service request, plus a one-tap call-back helpline.
